span.p:
Input（固定）
Owner: Product owner / Customer
职责: 定义客户需要 OPL App 云端产品的业务结果
状态: TARGET

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Console
Owner: apps/console-ui
职责: 展示 Basic/Pro、按 server quote 校验余额、提交命令、轮询原 Operation
状态: SOURCE
Gap: 无当前一致性缺口
Next Evidence: 同一 Candidate 的浏览器购买验收

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Control Plane
Owner: services/control-plane
职责: Session、报价/准入、Launch/Delete Saga、客户投影
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: WORKSPACE-PURCHASE-RECEIPT-PROJECTION-01（P1）
Next Evidence: Workspace/Billing/Admin 同一 Ledger Receipt ref

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Identity / Wallet / Key / Usage
Owner: Sub2API（外部权威）
职责: 可花余额、扣款、Key、路由、Usage
状态: SOURCE integration + BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01
Next Evidence: TKE 正常购买后的余额、Key、Usage readback

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Resource Fulfillment
Owner: services/fabric
职责: provider-neutral stage、资源身份、mutation/readback
状态: SOURCE
Gap: FABRIC-OPERATION-HISTORY-01（P2 verify）
Next Evidence: current source sealed scan + TKE owner receipt

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tencent/TKE Adapter
Owner: Fabric adapter；配置 Owner: opl-instance-medopl
职责: CVM/TKE/CBS/Kubernetes ACL 与权威回读
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: PORTABLE-INSTALL-01、INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01
Next Evidence: 显式 Profile/domain/image + same-Candidate TKE receipt

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Receipt / Evidence / Reconciliation
Owner: services/ledger
职责: append-only Receipt、Evidence Index、对账事实
状态: SOURCE
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01（缺 Instance receipt set）
Next Evidence: purchase/delete/qualification refs 绑定同一 Candidate

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
在线 OPL Workspace
Owner: Fabric 管 Runtime binding；OPL App 管工作台行为
职责: 认证 WebUI、项目/文件/产物连续工作
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01
Next Evidence: authenticated session + Ready Pod imageID + workspace_verified

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
medopl Tencent/TKE Qualification
Owner: opl-instance-medopl
职责: Profile、Secrets、部署、readback、执行回滚、receipt
状态: BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01（P0）
Next Evidence: generic admission + normal purchase + post-activation readback + rollback

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Current Candidate -> Formal Release
Owner: Cloud Candidate / Release owner
职责: 校验双路径回执并提升原 Candidate bytes
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: LOCAL-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-01、PRODUCT-RELEASE-01（P0）
Next Evidence: same digest 双路径 receipts + exact-byte promotion

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Output（固定）
Owner: OPL Cloud product owner
职责: 交付可移植、可治理、可追溯的 OPL Cloud 产品
状态: v0.1.7 历史 RELEASED；current successor BLOCKED
不声明 current TKE production-proven

div.style: color: rgb(52, 73, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Later（不阻断当前 Workspace Release）
Owner: Product owner（尚未选入当前 Release）
职责: 后续选择自助注册/支付、共享 Workspace、HA/GPU、Connect、Serve、Runway
状态: LATER

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
架构判断
Owner: Cloud architecture owner
职责: 约束业务核心、履约域、Provider ACL、证据域与钱包权威
三个 PostgreSQL owner 独立，无跨库写入
状态: 链路与 DDD / Clean Architecture 方向合理
